Create an 8-second photorealistic vertical 9:16 fashion transformation video.

REFERENCES
Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 109 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.55 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.68:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

0.68–1.13:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

1.13–1.80:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 1.80:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

1.80–3.45:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

3.45–3.95:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

3.95–4.30:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 4.30:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

4.30–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
Her right hand rests naturally by her side while her left fingertips touch lightly near her left collarbone and shoulder strap.
She stands front-facing with feet close together and a radiant smile.
End in this precise pose to connect to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 122 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.49 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.87:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

0.87–1.50:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

1.50–2.30:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 2.30:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

2.30–3.95:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

3.95–4.85:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

4.85–5.20:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 5.20:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

5.20–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
Her hands return to two relaxed loose fists just below her collarbones, elbows down.
She faces the camera, feet close together, weight mainly on her left leg, with a gentle smile.
End in this precise pose to connect to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

scenes_blueprint.prompt_chained_i2v:
Create an 8-second photorealistic vertical 9:16 fashion transformation video.

REFERENCES
Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 109 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.55 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.76:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

0.76–1.21:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

1.21–2.00:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 2.00:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

2.00–3.65:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

3.65–3.85:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

3.85–4.20:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 4.20:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

4.20–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
Her right hand rests naturally by her side while her left fingertips touch lightly near her left collarbone and shoulder strap.
She stands front-facing with feet close together and a radiant smile.
End in this precise pose to connect to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

Continue the same woman, bedroom, warm lighting, locked full-body camera, subject scale, facial identity and floor position.

She begins front-facing with her left fingertips touching lightly near her left collarbone and her right hand relaxed at her side.

Continue the lively 109 BPM travel-lookbook groove: light in-place stepping with clear floor contact, 45-degree side-to-front profile turns, and cheerful open-arm showcases.

0.00–0.76:
Continue the graceful sway from Clip 1 without resetting.
She lowers her left hand smoothly from her collarbone in a curved path while placing her right hand gently on her hip.

0.76–1.43:
She places her right hand gently on her right hip.
Her left forearm extends forward with a relaxed palm, then draws back across her upper torso.
A small weight shift initiates the arm movement; her torso remains mostly facing the camera.

1.43–1.73:
Her left wrist softly turns outward near shoulder height as she settles both feet, preparing the switch through the wrist accent without pausing.

AT 1.73:
Perform an instantaneous matched-pose switch into EXACT LOOK 3:
the pale-yellow ruched halter peplum top, white shorts, white socks, yellow ballet flats, cream chain-strap shoulder bag, blue cord necklace and red flower pendant, exactly as shown in Look 3.
The full outfit and accessories change together.
Keep her facial identity and preserve the moving hand's trajectory. No intermediate outfit.

1.73–2.70:
Complete the wrist turn naturally in Look 3: keeping her right hand softly at her hip, she gives one small head tilt, lets her left hand float down, and takes one short graceful step with clear floor contact.

2.70–2.95:
She adjusts the strap of her handbag lightly with one hand while angling her shoulders 15 degrees, maintaining a poised editorial gaze toward the camera lens.

2.95–3.20:
Raise her left hand into a small clean wrist flick near shoulder-cheek height while her right hand rests softly near her center torso.
Keep her face fully unobstructed.

AT 3.20:
At the peak of the wrist flick, perform an instantaneous matched-pose switch into EXACT LOOK 4 from the character sheet:
the pale-yellow ruched halter peplum top, beige wide-leg trousers, black-and-white sneakers, warm brown shoulder bag, dark sunglasses, high bun with yellow bow clip, and blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The hairstyle, glasses, clothing and accessories switch coherently in the same visual instant.
Preserve her face, head position and body proportions.
Remove the previous Look 3 accessory set.

3.20–6.15:
Continue the hand movement smoothly after the switch: her left hand lowers, then both arms fold loosely and comfortably across her torso as she smiles softly.

6.15–7.40:
With two small controlled steps, turn her body approximately 45 degrees toward screen right.
Keep her gaze briefly directed back toward the lens.
The garments and accessories follow naturally with restrained secondary motion.

7.40–8.00:
Holding the relaxed three-quarter pose, briefly bend the free knee and lift that heel a few centimetres behind her, then settle into a balanced final fashion pose.
Keep the movement small, elegant and physically plausible.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip: no singing, speech, humming or sound effects.
She may make subtle silent mouth expressions, but should not perform audible vocals.
The original music will be added continuously during editing.

AVOID
Identity changes, exaggerated hip motion, rigid posing, sudden limb snaps, foot sliding, floating feet, extra fingers, glasses warping, mixed outfits, leftover bags, duplicate accessories, magical transformation effects, dissolves, camera movement, background changes, captions, labels and reference-sheet layouts.

Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 109 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.55 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

0.00–1.35:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.

1.35–2.90:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

2.90–3.70:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

5.15–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

Her right hand rests naturally by her side while her left fingertips touch lightly near her left collarbone and shoulder strap.
She stands front-facing with feet close together and a radiant smile.
End in this precise pose to connect to the next clip.

Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.

scenes_blueprint.prompt_chained_i2v:
Create an 8-second photorealistic vertical 9:16 fashion transformation video.

REFERENCES
Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 109 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.55 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–1.35:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

1.35–3.70:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

3.70–4.50:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 4.50:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

4.50–6.15:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

6.15–6.85:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

6.85–7.20:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 7.20:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

7.20–7.60:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.60–8.00:
She brings both hands lightly together at waist level in front of her torso, shoulders relaxed and slightly angled.
She looks directly into the lens with a sweet, photogenic smile and steady foot contact.
End in this exact posture to connect to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 115 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.52 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

0.00–0.42:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.

0.42–0.87:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

0.87–1.10:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 1.10:

pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.

Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

2.75–3.95:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

3.95–4.30:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 4.30:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

4.30–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
She holds her left forearm softly across her waist while her right hand waves gently at chest height with a charming smile.
End in this exact pose to connect seamlessly to the next clip.

Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

Create an 8-second photorealistic vertical 9:16 fashion transformation video.

REFERENCES
Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 109 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.55 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–1.22:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

1.22–2.40:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

2.40–3.20:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 3.20:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.

Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

3.20–4.51:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

4.51–4.71:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

4.71–5.06:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 5.06:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

5.06–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
She brings both hands lightly together at waist level in front of her torso, shoulders relaxed and slightly angled.
She looks directly into the lens with a sweet, photogenic smile and steady foot contact.
End in this exact posture to connect to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

Create an 8-second photorealistic vertical 9:16 fashion transformation video.

Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 109 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.55 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.81:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

0.81–1.34:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

1.34–2.14:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 2.14:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.

Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

2.14–3.79:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

3.79–4.15:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

4.15–4.50:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 4.50:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

4.50–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
She brings both hands lightly together at waist level in front of her torso, shoulders relaxed and slightly angled.
She looks directly into the lens with a sweet, photogenic smile and steady foot contact.
End in this exact posture to connect to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

2.40–3.20:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.

She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

She looks directly into the lens with a sweet, photogenic smile and steady foot contact.

Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

Use a relaxed, feminine approximately 158 BPM fashion-dance feel: gentle weight transfers approximately every 0.38 seconds, with soft knees, relaxed shoulders, curved arm paths and fluid wrist accents. Hair and fabric follow her motion with a small natural delay.

She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.

Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.

Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

4.88–6.09:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.

6.09–6.44:

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

6.44–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
She holds her left forearm softly across her waist while her right hand waves gently at chest height with a charming smile.
End in this exact pose to connect seamlessly to the next clip.

Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a relaxed, feminine approximately 158 BPM fashion-dance feel: gentle weight transfers approximately every 0.38 seconds, with soft knees, relaxed shoulders, curved arm paths and fluid wrist accents. Hair and fabric follow her motion with a small natural delay.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.78:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

0.78–1.26:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

1.26–2.06:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 2.06:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

2.06–3.71:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

3.71–4.91:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

4.91–5.26:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 5.26:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

5.26–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
She brings both hands lightly together at waist level in front of her torso, shoulders relaxed and slightly angled.
She looks directly into the lens with a sweet, photogenic smile and steady foot contact.
End in this exact posture to connect to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a relaxed, feminine approximately 109 BPM fashion-dance feel: gentle weight transfers approximately every 0.55 seconds, with soft knees, relaxed shoulders, curved arm paths and fluid wrist accents. Hair and fabric follow her motion with a small natural delay.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–1.23:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

1.23–2.44:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

2.44–3.24:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 3.24:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

3.24–4.89:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

4.89–6.47:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

6.47–6.82:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 6.82:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

6.82–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
She brings both hands lightly together at waist level in front of her torso, shoulders relaxed and slightly angled.
She looks directly into the lens with a sweet, photogenic smile and steady foot contact.
End in this exact posture to connect to the next clip.

Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.

Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 113 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.53 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.

On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

6.94–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

She brings both hands lightly together at waist level in front of her torso, shoulders relaxed and slightly angled.
She looks directly into the lens with a sweet, photogenic smile and steady foot contact.
End in this exact posture to connect to the next clip.

scenes_blueprint.prompt_chained_i2v:
Create an 8-second photorealistic vertical 9:16 fashion transformation video.

REFERENCES
Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 111 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.54 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.82:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

0.82–1.36:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

1.36–2.16:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 2.16:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

2.16–3.81:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

3.81–5.85:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

5.85–6.20:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 6.20:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

6.20–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
She holds her left forearm softly across her waist while her right hand waves gently at chest height with a charming smile.
End in this exact pose to connect seamlessly to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

2.77–3.57:

Her smile remains understated and natural.

5.85–6.20:

On the beat peak of the hip pivot and waist sweep, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

6.20–7.58:
Complete the turn smoothly back to face the camera as the Look 2 hem and accessories settle with a natural bounce.

She brings both hands lightly together at waist level in front of her torso, shoulders relaxed and slightly angled.

Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

0.00–0.95:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.

0.95–1.70:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

1.70–2.50:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

3.65–3.85:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

3.85–4.20:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 4.20:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

4.20–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

She holds her left forearm softly across her waist while her right hand waves gently at chest height with a charming smile.
End in this exact pose to connect seamlessly to the next clip.

Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 111 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.54 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.66:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

0.66–1.11:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

1.11–1.73:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 1.73:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.

Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

3.38–4.75:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

4.75–5.10:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 5.10:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

5.10–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
She brings both hands lightly together at waist level in front of her torso, shoulders relaxed and slightly angled.
She looks directly into the lens with a sweet, photogenic smile and steady foot contact.
End in this exact posture to connect to the next clip.

Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a relaxed, feminine approximately 111 BPM fashion-dance feel: gentle weight transfers approximately every 0.54 seconds, with soft knees, relaxed shoulders, curved arm paths and fluid wrist accents. Hair and fabric follow her motion with a small natural delay.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–1.35:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

1.35–4.10:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

4.10–4.90:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 4.90:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

4.90–6.55:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

6.55–6.82:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

6.82–7.17:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 7.17:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

7.17–7.59:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.59–8.00:
She holds her left forearm softly across her waist while her right hand waves gently at chest height with a charming smile.
End in this exact pose to connect seamlessly to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.

Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

6.03–7.58:
Complete the turn smoothly back to face the camera as the Look 2 hem and accessories settle with a natural bounce.

She rests her right hand lightly on her right hip while her left hand settles softly near her center waist with fingers relaxed.

Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 109 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.55 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–0.85:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

0.85–1.44:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

1.44–2.24:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 2.24:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.

scenes_blueprint.prompt_chained_i2v:
Create an 8-second photorealistic vertical 9:16 fashion transformation video.

REFERENCES
Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 125 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.48 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–1.35:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

1.35–3.20:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

3.20–4.00:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 4.00:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

4.00–4.95:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

4.95–5.15:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

5.15–5.50:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 5.50:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

5.50–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.58–8.00:
She holds her left forearm softly across her waist while her right hand waves gently at chest height with a charming smile.
End in this exact pose to connect seamlessly to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

the pale-yellow ruched halter peplum top, white shorts, white socks, yellow ballet flats, cream chain-strap shoulder bag, blue cord necklace and red flower pendant, exactly as shown in Look 3.

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.

Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 158 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.38 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

0.00–1.35:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

1.35–3.07:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

3.07–3.87:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 3.87:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

3.87–5.52:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

5.52–6.85:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

6.85–7.20:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 7.20:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

7.20–7.60:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.60–8.00:
She places both hands lightly on her hips with elbows softly relaxed, facing the camera squarely with confident posture and a bright smile.
End in this exact pose to connect to the next clip.

Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.

Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 122 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.49 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

0.00–0.74:

0.74–1.19:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

1.19–1.95:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.

Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

3.60–4.18:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.

4.18–4.53:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

4.53–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

She places both hands lightly on her hips with elbows softly relaxed, facing the camera squarely with confident posture and a bright smile.

Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.

the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.

Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 120 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.50 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.

Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

6.35–6.70:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

6.70–7.58:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

She holds her left forearm softly across her waist while her right hand waves gently at chest height with a charming smile.

Create an 8-second photorealistic vertical 9:16 fashion transformation video.

REFERENCES
Use the supplied bedroom image [07_Nhan_Vat_Basic_Phong_Ngu_2K.png] as the exact opening composition, character identity, basic outfit, room geometry and lighting reference.
Use the supplied character sheet [01_Character_Sheet_4_Outfits_2K.png] only for the same woman's identity and the exact Look 1 and Look 2 outfits. The sheet must never appear in the video.

IDENTITY AND CAMERA
Preserve her facial structure, long wavy brown hair, natural skin texture, body proportions and adult appearance.
Keep the warm bedroom, brown curtains, bed and cabinet consistent.
Locked camera, continuous full-body framing with both feet visible, consistent subject scale and floor contact.

MOVEMENT
Use a breezy, upbeat approximately 113 BPM street-and-travel lookbook feel (beat accent every 0.53 seconds): light walking-in-place steps, charming hat/hair/collar touches, wide welcoming arm arcs, and natural fabric sway.

TIMELINE — LOCAL CLIP TIME

0.00–1.35:
Begin in the exact basic outfit: white T-shirt, loose light-blue jeans and cream slides.
She looks into the lens with a soft smile, gently transfers her weight left and right, raises her left forearm with the palm facing upward, then softly sweeps that hand inward across her upper torso.

1.35–3.70:
She opens both forearms outward at waist level, brings her hands lightly toward shoulder height, then makes one small playful forward pointing gesture and smoothly retracts it.
Keep the elbows relaxed; this is casual musical movement rather than an energetic dance routine.

3.70–4.50:
Her hands lower naturally, then she shifts onto her right leg and lifts her left hand toward her left shoulder, preparing a crisp wrist flick on the beat.

AT 4.50:
At the peak of the shoulder-level wrist flick, perform one instantaneous matched-pose wardrobe switch into EXACT LOOK 1:
pale-yellow halter-neck ruched asymmetric peplum top, cobalt-blue wide-leg trousers, yellow shoulder bag, yellow-and-white sneakers, blue cord necklace with red flower pendant.
The entire outfit and its accessories switch together in a single clean visual beat.
Preserve her face, body position, arm trajectory and bedroom. No dissolve or intermediate clothing.

4.50–6.15:
Continue the same wrist movement after the switch: she extends her left hand gently toward the lens, opens her fingers, then retracts her hand along a smooth curved path while making a subtle shoulder sway.

6.15–6.85:
She takes one small in-place step, softly tilts her head and brings both relaxed hands toward her upper chest.
Her smile remains understated and natural.

6.85–7.20:
She makes a small downward knee pulse and begins opening both forearms outward at waist-to-chest level, preparing the second switch on the beat.

AT 7.20:
On the outward two-hand accent, switch instantaneously into EXACT LOOK 2 from the character sheet:
the yellow tiered mini dress with its rounded gathered hem, white socks, yellow ballet flats, and the matching yellow hair and wrist accessories shown in Look 2.
Replace the complete Look 1 accessory set with the exact Look 2 set.
Maintain the same identity, body position and continuous arm movement.

7.20–7.60:
She completes the outward arm opening and settles her weight smoothly onto her supporting leg as the garment hem gives one small natural bounce and settles.

7.60–8.00:
She places both hands lightly on her hips with elbows softly relaxed, facing the camera squarely with confident posture and a bright smile.
End in this exact pose to connect to the next clip.

AUDIO AND MOUTH
Generate a silent visual clip. No speech, singing, humming, breathing performance or sound effects.
Her lips may remain softly closed or make tiny silent expressive movements.
Do not invent lyric-specific lip synchronization without the original audio reference.

AVOID
Face drift, body reshaping, extra fingers, rigid elbows, robotic dance, foot sliding, jumping, camera cuts, camera movement, flashing light, magical particles, melting fabric, partial outfits, mixed accessories, text, captions, labels, logos, duplicated people or visible reference-sheet panels.
